name: ZC & ZS Carry Quintile Seasonality Heatmap
description: Monthly heatmap of average carry quintile by calendar month (Jan-Dec) x year for Corn (ZC) and Soybeans (ZS) futures. Carry is ranked via percentrank(period=252) on the futures_continuation carry output, then mapped to quintiles Q1 (deepest contango, pctrank 0-20) through Q5 (deepest backwardation, pctrank 80-100). Each cell shows the mean daily quintile reading for that month-year, revealing whether certain calendar months tend to cluster in contango or backwardation regimes. Red=Q1 contango, Green=Q5 backwardation. NoAdjustment used to preserve real carry levels.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ZC & ZS CARRY QUINTILE SEASONALITY HEATMAP
# =============================================================================
#
# For each asset (ZC corn, ZS soybeans):
#   1. Build front-month continuation with NoAdjustment (preserves real carry levels)
#   2. Compute percentrank(252) on cont.carry → 0-100 scale
#   3. Map to quintiles: Q1=0-20 (deepest contango), Q5=80-100 (deepest backwardation)
#   4. Extract calendar month + year
#   5. Heatmap: x=month (Jan-Dec), y=year, cell=mean daily quintile for that month-year
#
# NoAdjustment is critical: BackwardPanamaCanal shifts historical prices by
# cumulative additive gaps at each roll, distorting carry levels over long histories.
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary asset (ZC or ZS depending on context) ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# --- Carry: front/back - 1 (positive=backwardation, negative=contango) ---
carry = cont.carry

# --- Percentrank(252) on carry: 0=lowest carry (deepest contango), 100=highest (deepest backwardation) ---
carry_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(carry)

# --- Map percentrank to quintiles Q1-Q5 ---
# Q1: 0-20  = deepest contango
# Q2: 20-40
# Q3: 40-60 = neutral
# Q4: 60-80
# Q5: 80-100 = deepest backwardation
quintile = conditional_select(
    is_valid(carry_pctrank) and carry_pctrank <= 20, 1.0,
    is_valid(carry_pctrank) and carry_pctrank <= 40, 2.0,
    is_valid(carry_pctrank) and carry_pctrank <= 60, 3.0,
    is_valid(carry_pctrank) and carry_pctrank <= 80, 4.0,
    is_valid(carry_pctrank),                          5.0,
    carry_pctrank  # fallback (NaN when carry_pctrank is NaN)
)

# --- Calendar coordinates ---
ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)
year_num  = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(ts)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT: Carry Quintile Seasonality Heatmap
# x = calendar month (Jan-Dec), y = year, cell = mean quintile
# Red (Q1 contango) → Green (Q5 backwardation)
# color_axis_min/max pinned to 1-5 so scale is consistent across both assets
# =============================================================================
heatmap(
    title='Carry Quintile by Month x Year (Q1=Contango, Q5=Backwardation)',
    category='Carry Quintile Seasonality',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    x_axis_label='Calendar Month',
    y_axis_label='Year',
    min_color=Color.Red,
    max_color=Color.Green,
    null_color=Color.Gray,
    color_axis_min=1.0,
    color_axis_max=5.0,
    value_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.2f}',
    show_data_labels=True,
    order=1
)(x=month_num, y=year_num, value=quintile)
